title: Passport Index Database
description: Tracking historical changes in passport rankings and visa requirements.

top_passport.sql: SELECT c.name as country, c.code as country_code, cr.year as ranking_year, cr.rank, cr.visa_free_count FROM Country c JOIN CountryRanking cr ON c.code = cr.country_code WHERE cr.year = CASE WHEN :year IS NULL OR :year = '' THEN (SELECT MAX(year) FROM CountryRanking) ELSE :year END ORDER BY cr.rank ASC, c.name ASC LIMIT CASE WHEN :limit IS NULL OR :limit = '' THEN 20 ELSE :limit END
top_passport.title: Top Passport Rankings
top_passport.description: Ranks passports from strongest to weakest for the selected year. A blank year uses the latest available ranking; a blank limit shows the top 20 passports. Parameters: year (YYYY) and limit (number of results).

bottom_passport.sql: SELECT c.name as country, c.code as country_code, cr.year as ranking_year, cr.rank, cr.visa_free_count FROM Country c JOIN CountryRanking cr ON c.code = cr.country_code WHERE cr.year = CASE WHEN :year IS NULL OR :year = '' THEN (SELECT MAX(year) FROM CountryRanking) ELSE :year END ORDER BY cr.rank DESC, c.name ASC LIMIT CASE WHEN :limit IS NULL OR :limit = '' THEN 20 ELSE :limit END
bottom_passport.title: Bottom Passport Rankings
bottom_passport.description: Ranks passports from weakest to strongest for the selected year. A blank year uses the latest available ranking; a blank limit shows the bottom 20 passports. Parameters: year (YYYY) and limit (number of results).

passport_ranking_trends.sql: WITH resolved AS ( SELECT COALESCE( (SELECT code FROM Country WHERE code = UPPER(:country) OR LOWER(name) = LOWER(:country) ORDER BY CASE WHEN code = UPPER(:country) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END LIMIT 1), (SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MIN(code) END FROM Country WHERE LOWER(name) LIKE '%' || LOWER(:country) || '%') ) AS code ), yearly_ranks AS ( SELECT c.name as country, c.code as country_code, cr.year, cr.rank, cr.visa_free_count, LAG(cr.rank) OVER (PARTITION BY cr.country_code ORDER BY cr.year) as prev_rank, LAG(cr.visa_free_count) OVER (PARTITION BY cr.country_code ORDER BY cr.year) as prev_visa_free_count FROM CountryRanking cr JOIN Country c ON cr.country_code = c.code WHERE (:country IS NULL OR :country = '' OR cr.country_code = (SELECT code FROM resolved)) ) SELECT country, country_code, year, rank, visa_free_count, (prev_rank - rank) as rank_improvement, (visa_free_count - prev_visa_free_count) as visa_free_increase FROM yearly_ranks WHERE prev_rank IS NOT NULL ORDER BY year DESC, rank_improvement DESC LIMIT CASE WHEN :limit IS NULL OR :limit = '' THEN 100 ELSE :limit END
passport_ranking_trends.title: Passport Ranking Changes
passport_ranking_trends.description: Shows year-to-year changes in passport rankings and visa-free destination counts. A positive rank change means the passport moved up the ranking. Leave country blank to include all passports; an ambiguous or unmatched country returns no rows. A blank limit shows up to 100 results. Parameters: country (code or name) and limit (number of results).

passport_strength.sql: SELECT c.region, cr.year as ranking_year, ROUND(AVG(cr.rank), 2) as avg_rank, ROUND(AVG(cr.visa_free_count), 2) as avg_visa_free_count, MIN(cr.rank) as best_rank, MAX(cr.visa_free_count) as max_visa_free_count, COUNT(DISTINCT c.code) as countries_in_region FROM Country c JOIN CountryRanking cr ON c.code = cr.country_code AND cr.year = CASE WHEN :year IS NULL OR :year = '' THEN (SELECT MAX(year) FROM CountryRanking) ELSE :year END GROUP BY c.region, cr.year ORDER BY cr.year DESC, avg_rank ASC
passport_strength.title: Passport Rankings by Region
passport_strength.description: Compares average passport ranking and visa-free destination counts by region. A lower average rank means stronger passports. The year column shows the ranking year; a blank year uses the latest available ranking. Parameter: year (YYYY).

current_visa_reciprocity.sql: WITH resolved_from AS ( SELECT CASE WHEN :from_country IS NULL OR :from_country = '' THEN 'MY' ELSE COALESCE( (SELECT code FROM Country WHERE code = UPPER(:from_country) OR LOWER(name) = LOWER(:from_country) ORDER BY CASE WHEN code = UPPER(:from_country) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END LIMIT 1), (SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MIN(code) END FROM Country WHERE LOWER(name) LIKE '%' || LOWER(:from_country) || '%') ) END AS code ), resolved_to AS ( SELECT CASE WHEN :to_country IS NULL OR :to_country = '' THEN NULL ELSE COALESCE( (SELECT code FROM Country WHERE code = UPPER(:to_country) OR LOWER(name) = LOWER(:to_country) ORDER BY CASE WHEN code = UPPER(:to_country) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END LIMIT 1), (SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MIN(code) END FROM Country WHERE LOWER(name) LIKE '%' || LOWER(:to_country) || '%') ) END AS code ), latest_requirements AS ( SELECT vr.from_country, vr.to_country, vr.requirement_type, vr.effective_date FROM VisaRequirement vr WHERE vr.effective_date = ( SELECT MAX(effective_date) FROM VisaRequirement WHERE from_country = vr.from_country AND to_country = vr.to_country ) ) SELECT c1.name as from_country, outbound.from_country as from_country_code, c2.name as to_country, outbound.to_country as to_country_code, outbound.requirement_type as outbound_requirement, inbound.requirement_type as inbound_requirement, CASE WHEN inbound.requirement_type IS NULL THEN 'Unknown' WHEN outbound.requirement_type = inbound.requirement_type THEN 'Symmetric' ELSE 'Asymmetric' END as relationship, outbound.effective_date as outbound_recorded_date, inbound.effective_date as inbound_recorded_date FROM latest_requirements outbound LEFT JOIN latest_requirements inbound ON outbound.from_country = inbound.to_country AND outbound.to_country = inbound.from_country JOIN Country c1 ON outbound.from_country = c1.code JOIN Country c2 ON outbound.to_country = c2.code WHERE outbound.from_country = (SELECT code FROM resolved_from) AND ( :to_country IS NULL OR :to_country = '' OR outbound.to_country = (SELECT code FROM resolved_to) ) AND ( :relationship IS NULL OR :relationship = '' OR (LOWER(:relationship) = 'symmetric' AND inbound.requirement_type IS NOT NULL AND outbound.requirement_type = inbound.requirement_type) OR (LOWER(:relationship) = 'asymmetric' AND inbound.requirement_type IS NOT NULL AND outbound.requirement_type != inbound.requirement_type) OR (LOWER(:relationship) = 'unknown' AND inbound.requirement_type IS NULL) ) ORDER BY c1.name, c2.name LIMIT CASE WHEN :limit IS NULL OR :limit = '' THEN 100 ELSE :limit END
current_visa_reciprocity.title: Passport Destinations and Visa Reciprocity
current_visa_reciprocity.description: Shows the latest recorded visa requirement for each destination from the selected passport, plus the destination's requirement for travelers going the other way when that record exists. Missing reverse data is unknown, not asymmetric. Each recorded date is when this database captured that requirement, not a confirmed policy start date. A blank origin defaults to Malaysia (MY); blank destination and relationship filters include all destinations. Country filters accept codes, exact names, or unique partial names. Relationship accepts symmetric, asymmetric, or unknown; symmetric/asymmetric filters exclude destinations without reverse data. A blank limit shows up to 100 destinations. Parameters: from_country, to_country, relationship, and limit.

global_visa_types_overview.sql: WITH selected_year AS ( SELECT CASE WHEN :year IS NULL OR :year = '' THEN (SELECT MAX(strftime('%Y', effective_date)) FROM VisaRequirement) ELSE :year END AS year ), latest_requirements AS ( SELECT vr.from_country, vr.to_country, vr.requirement_type FROM VisaRequirement vr JOIN selected_year sy ON strftime('%Y', vr.effective_date) <= sy.year WHERE vr.effective_date = ( SELECT MAX(effective_date) FROM VisaRequirement WHERE from_country = vr.from_country AND to_country = vr.to_country AND strftime('%Y', effective_date) <= sy.year ) ), coverage AS ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT from_country) AS observed_origin_count, COUNT(*) AS observed_pair_count FROM latest_requirements ) SELECT (SELECT year FROM selected_year) as year, requirement_type, COUNT(*) as count, ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 2) as percentage, (SELECT observed_origin_count FROM coverage) AS observed_origin_count, (SELECT observed_pair_count FROM coverage) AS observed_pair_count FROM latest_requirements GROUP BY requirement_type
global_visa_types_overview.title: Visa Requirements Worldwide
global_visa_types_overview.description: Counts the latest recorded visa categories for observed country pairs up to the selected year. The year is the reporting period; individual pair recording dates vary. Counts and percentages cover observed pairs only, not every possible country pair. Results include the number of observed origin passports and pairs. A blank year uses the latest year with recorded requirements. Parameter: year (YYYY).

regional_visa_patterns.sql: WITH selected_year AS ( SELECT CASE WHEN :year IS NULL OR :year = '' THEN (SELECT MAX(strftime('%Y', effective_date)) FROM VisaRequirement) ELSE :year END AS year ), latest_requirements AS ( SELECT vr.from_country, vr.to_country, vr.requirement_type FROM VisaRequirement vr JOIN selected_year sy ON strftime('%Y', vr.effective_date) <= sy.year WHERE vr.effective_date = ( SELECT MAX(effective_date) FROM VisaRequirement WHERE from_country = vr.from_country AND to_country = vr.to_country AND strftime('%Y', effective_date) <= sy.year ) ) SELECT c_from.region as from_region, c_to.region as to_region, SUM(lr.requirement_type = 'visa_free_access') as visa_free_access, SUM(lr.requirement_type = 'visa_required') as visa_required, SUM(lr.requirement_type = 'visa_on_arrival') as visa_on_arrival, SUM(lr.requirement_type = 'visa_online') as visa_online, SUM(lr.requirement_type = 'electronic_travel_authorisation') as electronic_travel_authorisation FROM latest_requirements lr JOIN Country c_from ON lr.from_country = c_from.code JOIN Country c_to ON lr.to_country = c_to.code WHERE (:from_region IS NULL OR :from_region = '' OR UPPER(c_from.region) = UPPER(:from_region)) AND (:to_region IS NULL OR :to_region = '' OR UPPER(c_to.region) = UPPER(:to_region)) GROUP BY c_from.region, c_to.region ORDER BY c_from.region, c_to.region LIMIT CASE WHEN :limit IS NULL OR :limit = '' THEN 100 ELSE :limit END
regional_visa_patterns.title: Visa Requirements Between Regions
regional_visa_patterns.description: Counts recorded visa categories for observed origin and destination region pairs up to the selected year. The year is the reporting period; individual pair recording dates vary. Leave either region blank to include all regions. A blank year uses the latest year with recorded requirements; a blank limit shows up to 100 region pairs. Parameters: year (YYYY), from_region, to_region, and limit.

globally_restricted_destinations.sql: WITH latest_requirements AS ( SELECT vr.from_country, vr.to_country, vr.requirement_type FROM VisaRequirement vr WHERE vr.effective_date = ( SELECT MAX(effective_date) FROM VisaRequirement WHERE from_country = vr.from_country AND to_country = vr.to_country ) ), coverage AS ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT from_country) AS observed_origin_count FROM latest_requirements ) SELECT c.name as destination, c.code as destination_code, c.region as destination_region, COUNT(*) as visa_required_count, ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT observed_origin_count FROM coverage), 2) as percentage_observed_origins_requiring_visa, (SELECT observed_origin_count FROM coverage) AS observed_origin_count FROM latest_requirements vr JOIN Country c ON vr.to_country = c.code WHERE vr.requirement_type = 'visa_required' GROUP BY vr.to_country ORDER BY visa_required_count DESC, c.name LIMIT CASE WHEN :limit IS NULL OR :limit = '' THEN 20 ELSE :limit END
globally_restricted_destinations.title: Top Destinations Requiring Visas
globally_restricted_destinations.description: Ranks destinations by how many observed origin passports require a visa to enter. Counts use the latest recorded requirement for each pair, and different pairs may have been recorded on different dates. Percentages use only origin passports with recorded requirements, not every passport worldwide; results include the number of observed origins used. A blank limit shows the top 20 destinations. Parameter: limit (number of results).

historical_visa_policy_changes.sql: SELECT vr2.effective_date as change_date, c1.name as from_country, c1.code as from_country_code, c2.name as to_country, c2.code as to_country_code, vr1.requirement_type as old_requirement, vr1.effective_date as old_recorded_date, vr2.requirement_type as new_requirement, vr2.effective_date as new_recorded_date, CASE WHEN vr1.requirement_type = 'visa_required' AND vr2.requirement_type IN ('visa_free_access', 'visa_on_arrival', 'visa_online', 'electronic_travel_authorisation') THEN 'Liberalization' WHEN vr1.requirement_type IN ('visa_free_access', 'visa_on_arrival', 'visa_online', 'electronic_travel_authorisation') AND vr2.requirement_type = 'visa_required' THEN 'Restriction' ELSE 'Policy Change' END as change_type FROM VisaRequirement vr1 JOIN VisaRequirement vr2 ON vr1.from_country = vr2.from_country AND vr1.to_country = vr2.to_country AND vr2.effective_date > vr1.effective_date JOIN Country c1 ON vr1.from_country = c1.code JOIN Country c2 ON vr1.to_country = c2.code WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM VisaRequirement vr3 WHERE vr3.from_country = vr1.from_country AND vr3.to_country = vr1.to_country AND vr3.effective_date > vr1.effective_date AND vr3.effective_date < vr2.effective_date ) AND (:from_country IS NULL OR :from_country = '' OR c1.code = UPPER(:from_country) OR LOWER(c1.name) LIKE '%' || LOWER(:from_country) || '%') AND (:to_country IS NULL OR :to_country = '' OR c2.code = UPPER(:to_country) OR LOWER(c2.name) LIKE '%' || LOWER(:to_country) || '%') AND (:year_from IS NULL OR :year_from = '' OR strftime('%Y', vr2.effective_date) >= :year_from) AND (:year_to IS NULL OR :year_to = '' OR strftime('%Y', vr2.effective_date) <= :year_to) ORDER BY vr2.effective_date DESC LIMIT CASE WHEN :limit IS NULL OR :limit = '' THEN 100 ELSE :limit END
historical_visa_policy_changes.title: Visa Requirement Changes Over Time
historical_visa_policy_changes.description: Shows recorded visa-category changes for each origin and destination pair. The dates show when this database recorded the old and new categories, not when a policy was confirmed to take effect. Liberalization means a change away from visa required; restriction means a change to visa required. Leave country and year filters blank to include all values. Country filters accept codes, exact names, or partial names, which may match multiple countries. A blank limit shows up to 100 changes. Parameters: from_country, to_country, year_from, year_to, and limit.

most_volatile_policies.sql: SELECT c1.name as from_country, c1.code as from_country_code, c2.name as to_country, c2.code as to_country_code, COUNT(*) - 1 as change_count, MIN(vr.effective_date) as first_recorded, MAX(vr.effective_date) as last_recorded_change FROM VisaRequirement vr JOIN Country c1 ON vr.from_country = c1.code JOIN Country c2 ON vr.to_country = c2.code WHERE (:from_country IS NULL OR :from_country = '' OR c1.code = UPPER(:from_country) OR LOWER(c1.name) LIKE '%' || LOWER(:from_country) || '%') AND (:to_country IS NULL OR :to_country = '' OR c2.code = UPPER(:to_country) OR LOWER(c2.name) LIKE '%' || LOWER(:to_country) || '%') GROUP BY vr.from_country, vr.to_country HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY change_count DESC LIMIT CASE WHEN :limit IS NULL OR :limit = '' THEN 50 ELSE :limit END
most_volatile_policies.title: Visa Routes with the Most Recorded Changes
most_volatile_policies.description: Ranks origin and destination pairs by the number of recorded visa-category changes. First and last dates are when this database recorded requirements, not confirmed policy start or change dates. Leave country filters blank to include all countries; partial names may match multiple countries. A blank limit shows up to 50 routes. Parameters: from_country, to_country, and limit.

recent_changes.sql: WITH dates AS ( SELECT DISTINCT effective_date FROM VisaRequirement ORDER BY effective_date DESC LIMIT 2 ), curr AS (SELECT MAX(effective_date) AS d FROM dates), prev AS (SELECT MIN(effective_date) AS d FROM dates), snapshots AS ( SELECT d.effective_date AS snapshot_date, vr.from_country, vr.to_country, vr.requirement_type FROM dates d JOIN VisaRequirement vr ON vr.effective_date = ( SELECT MAX(effective_date) FROM VisaRequirement WHERE from_country = vr.from_country AND to_country = vr.to_country AND effective_date <= d.effective_date ) ), pair_states AS ( SELECT from_country, to_country, MAX(CASE WHEN snapshot_date = (SELECT d FROM curr) THEN requirement_type END) AS current_requirement, MAX(CASE WHEN snapshot_date = (SELECT d FROM prev) THEN requirement_type END) AS previous_requirement FROM snapshots GROUP BY from_country, to_country ) SELECT (SELECT d FROM curr) AS current_date, (SELECT d FROM prev) AS previous_date, c.region AS from_region, SUM(current_requirement = 'visa_free_access') - SUM(previous_requirement = 'visa_free_access') AS visa_free_access, SUM(current_requirement = 'visa_required') - SUM(previous_requirement = 'visa_required') AS visa_required, SUM(current_requirement = 'visa_on_arrival') - SUM(previous_requirement = 'visa_on_arrival') AS visa_on_arrival, SUM(current_requirement = 'visa_online') - SUM(previous_requirement = 'visa_online') AS visa_online, SUM(current_requirement = 'electronic_travel_authorisation') - SUM(previous_requirement = 'electronic_travel_authorisation') AS electronic_travel_authorisation, SUM(previous_requirement IS NULL AND current_requirement IS NOT NULL) AS newly_observed_pairs FROM pair_states ps JOIN Country c ON ps.from_country = c.code GROUP BY c.region HAVING SUM(current_requirement IS NOT previous_requirement) > 0 ORDER BY from_region
recent_changes.title: Latest Recorded Visa Changes
recent_changes.description: Summarizes category changes between the two most recent dates when visa-requirement changes were recorded in this database. These observation dates are not the date of the latest successful scrape or confirmed policy-effective dates. Newly observed pairs had no earlier recorded requirement, so their previous category is unknown. This summary has no parameters.

Country.description: Information about countries included in the passport index

CountryRanking.description: Annual rankings and visa-free travel counts for countries
